aggregate_transport.rule: Routine carts, pack animals and handlers are aggregate logistical capacity. Route movements reserve freight kg and crew capacity; no ordinary animal or vehicle becomes an exact persistent object.

escort.assignment_rule: Acceptance claims the contract for a beneficiary institution and records its principal participants. Martial escorts are exact people. Ordinary freight transport and civilian handlers are pooled logistical capacity reserved from the source settlement or faction; they are never materialized as one object per animal/wagon. No person, cargo, money, or capacity is conjured.

funding_rule: Every offered contract escrows its promised institutional payment from the exact issuer before acceptance. No unfunded reward is created.
generation_rule: Escort demand may protect cargo, persistent people, traveling parties, or mixed convoys. Aggregate regional shortages are demand signals, not single shipments: ordinary public cargo offers commission one physically planned lot at a time. The publication target is not a world maximum; larger deliberate movements require correspondingly larger real transport, crew, provisions and security.
assignment_rule: Acceptance claims the contract for a beneficiary institution and records its principal participants. A leader's active standing retinue is a persistent three-person travel team, not the mission's entire guard establishment. Departure uses that core team first; if the physical contract minimum is larger, the beneficiary institution temporarily assigns only the additional ready same-faction martial staff required at the route origin. Those mission staff are committed only for that contract and do not become standing retinue members. Civilian drivers, handlers, attendants and protected clients are not counted as martial escorts. No person or capacity is conjured.
compensation_rule: Institutional contract revenue is paid to the beneficiary treasury. Faction members receive their normal monthly institutional compensation unless an explicit faction bonus policy exists; independent escorts may be contracted for direct payment.
